fixes.explanation: Yes, you caught it, baker. False. Moses says the LORD “…will bring you into the land your fathers possessed, and you will take possession of it.” And then it gets better: “He will cause you to prosper and multiply more than your fathers.” (Deuteronomy 30:5) Less? No, no, no. That's MORE, friend, and I'd take a bigger batch over a smaller one any day of the week.
